description: Use this to see what a Chilean securities issuer disclosed to the CMF as material events (hechos esenciales): dividends, shareholders' meetings, management changes, securities placements, mergers and more. Pass rut and optionally days (how far back, default 365, up to 1825). Each event has filed_at, the topic in English and as published (topic_es), the document number and document_url (the filing, PDF in Spanish). The topic is the issuer's own choice; 'Other' says nothing about the content, so open the document before concluding. Access: open to anonymous agents (rate-limited); a free AndesPass key raises the limit.

days.description: How far back, in days (1 to 1825; default 365).
days.title: Days

rut.description: The issuer's RUT (Chilean tax id), e.g. 61.808.000-5.
rut.title: Rut

name: cmf_material_events
title: Chilean issuer material events
